title: Chinese diplomacy sets lofty goals for a new era
lede: China’s ambassador to the EU argues that from climate action to digital security, Beijing’s new diplomatic push seeks to bind Europe and the Global South into a growth model that rejects US-style alliances and old Cold War dividing lines.
